text: All tests pass and the fix is verified. The root cause was that `is_leap` only checked divisibility by 4, missing the century exception (years divisible by 100 are not leap years unless also divisible by 400). This made 1900 and 2100 count as leap years, adding a phantom Feb 29 to the ordinal day count.
